title: Nigerian Wedding Photographer in Birmingham: The Complete Guide
description: Birmingham holds one of the largest African diasporas outside London, and on wedding weekends that shows — banqueting halls across Edgbaston and Aston, community centres in Handsworth, and civic venues around Victoria Square fill with Aso-Ebi, gele and the sound of talking drums.
